name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.strictDecidePM_cost
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (k : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Costed.cost (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.strictDecidePM g k))
    (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.strictDecidePC g k)

source.code:
theorem strictDecidePM_cost (k : ℕ) : (g.strictDecidePM k).cost = g.strictDecidePC k := by
  unfold strictDecidePM strictDecidePC
  by_cases hk : 2 ≤ k
  · cases hv : g.isValid
    · simp [hk, hv, isValidGM_val, isValidGM_cost]
    · cases ht : g.base.testsDistinct g.base.canonIds
      · simp [hk, hv, ht, isValidGM_val, isValidGM_cost, canonIdsM_val, canonIdsM_cost,
          testsDistinctM_val, testsDistinctM_cost]
      · simp [hk, hv, ht, isValidGM_val, isValidGM_cost, canonIdsM_val, canonIdsM_cost,
          testsDistinctM_val, testsDistinctM_cost, rhoFlowM_val, rhoFlowM_cost]
        omega
  · simp [hk]

g : GInstance
k : ℕ
⊢ (do
        tick (natC 2 + natC k)
        if 2 ≤ k then do
            let v ← g.isValidGM
            if v = true then do
                let ids ← g.canonIdsM
                let d ← g.testsDistinctM ids
                if d = true then do
                    let r ← g.rhoFlowM ids
                    tick (natC k + natC (k + 1) + natC r)
                    Pure.pure (decide (k + 1 ≤ r))
                  else Pure.pure false
              else Pure.pure false
          else Pure.pure false).cost =
    natC 2 + natC k +
      if 2 ≤ k then
        g.isValidGC +
          if g.isValid = true then
            have ids := g.base.canonIds;
            g.base.canonIdsC' + g.base.testsDistinctC ids +
              if g.base.testsDistinct ids = true then g.rhoFlowCL ids + natC k + natC (k + 1) + natC (g.rhoFlowL ids)
              else 0
          else 0
      else 0
